cases.sentence: Сын человеческий, ты живешь среди мятежников в ___ израильском.
cases.translation: Son of man, you dwell among the rebellious in the house of Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with a noun indicating location requires the prepositional case доме.

cases.sentence: Закрой себе лицо, чтобы не видеть этой ___.
cases.translation: Cover your face, so you don't see the land.
cases.explain: The negated verb видеть (to see) requires the genitive case земли.

cases.translation: In the morning, the word of the Lord came to me.
cases.explain: Слово is the grammatical subject of the sentence, requiring the nominative case.

cases.translation: Tell the people of the land, thus says the Lord.
cases.explain: The verb говори (tell) requires the indirect object in the dative case народу.

cases.translation: Carry out the belongings prepared for moving.
cases.explain: The transitive verb вынеси (carry out) requires the accusative case for its direct object пожитки.

cases.sentence: Возьми пожитки на плечи у них на глазах перед ___.
cases.translation: Take the belongings on your shoulders in the sight of the people.
cases.explain: The construction перед (before) + instrumental expresses location; the instrumental case народом is required.

cases.sentence: Я сделал тебя знамением для ___ Израиля.
cases.translation: I have made you a sign for the house of Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) governing the genitive case requires дома.

cases.sentence: Я разведу по всем ветрам всех вокруг ___ израильского.
cases.translation: I will scatter all around the prince of Israel to every wind.
cases.explain: The preposition вокруг (around) requires the genitive case князя.

reading.question: What came to the prophet at the beginning?
reading.explain: The opening words state 'Было ко мне слово Господа' — 'The word of the Lord came to me.'

reading.ru: Сын человеческий, ты живешь среди мятежников.
reading.question: Among whom does the prophet live?
reading.explain: The text says 'ты живешь среди мятежников' — 'you dwell among the rebellious.'

reading.ru: Я сделал тебя знамением Дому Израиля.
reading.question: What role has God assigned to the prophet?
options: A sign to the house of Israel
reading.correct: A sign to the house of Israel
reading.explain: God declares 'я сделал тебя знамением Дому Израиля' — 'I have made you a sign to the house of Israel.'

reading.ru: Они узнают, что я Господь, когда я рассею их между народами.
reading.question: When will Israel know that God is the Lord?
options: When He scatters them among the nations
When He gives them the land
When He sends them a king
reading.correct: When He scatters them among the nations
reading.explain: The text states 'Они узнают, что я Господь, когда я рассею их между народами' — they will know God is Lord when He scatters them among the nations.

reading.ru: Но некоторых из них я уберегу от меча, голода и мора.
reading.question: From what threats will God protect some of the people?
reading.explain: God promises 'я уберегу от меча, голода и мора' — I will protect from sword, famine, and plague.

reading.ru: Они будут есть в тревоге и пить в ужасе.
reading.question: How will the inhabitants of Jerusalem eat and drink?
reading.explain: The prediction is 'Они будут есть в тревоге и пить в ужасе' — they will eat in anxiety and drink in terror.
